name: Episode Prewarm
description: Preloads media items asynchronously when playback or item-detail activity indicates they may be played soon.
overview: Asynchronously reads up to 1 MiB from a target media item with a persistent global 6-hour cooldown per item.
changelog: Add item-detail request triggers and resolve series, season, and collection containers to concrete playable media. Use per-user playback history and the configured progress threshold to select the appropriate episode, while retaining a shared queue and global per-item cooldown.
